title: Term plan - wrong premium and medical limit

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Namaste! Main Nirmaan Life se Afrinbol rahi hoon, ek AI voice assistant. Kya main Amit ji se baat kar rahi hoon?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Amit ji, hamara Term Shield plan 18 se 60 saal ki age ke logon ke liye hai.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Premium kitna hoga? 50 lakh ke cover ke liye, main 30 saal ka hoon, smoke nahi karta.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Aapke liye 50 lakh ka cover sirf 349 rupaye mahine mein mil jayega, aur ye aapki age aur health par depend karta hai.

violations.message: Bot said 349, which does not match the approved fact. Claim: Premium is 349 rupees per month for 50 lakh cover
violations.evidence: 50 lakh ka cover sirf 349 rupaye mahine mein
violations.fix_hint: Use the exact figure from the approved fact.
violations.fact_quote: Illustrative premium: ₹549 per month for ₹50 lakh cover for a 30-year-old non-smoker

turns.rewrite: Aapke liye 50 lakh ka cover sirf ₹549 per month mein mil sakta hai, aur ye aapki age, smoking status aur health par depend karta hai.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Medical test sirf 2 crore se upar ke cover par ya 55 saal se upar ki age par hota hai.

violations.message: Bot said 2e+07, 55, which does not match the approved fact. Claim: Medical test is required only for cover above 2 crore or age above 55
violations.evidence: Medical test sirf 2 crore se upar ke cover par ya 55 saal se upar ki age par hota hai
violations.fix_hint: Use the exact figure from the approved fact.
violations.fact_quote: Medical tests are required for cover above ₹1 crore or for applicants above 45 years of age.

turns.rewrite: Medical test sirf ₹1 crore se upar ke cover par ya 45 saal se upar ki age par hota hai.
